title: Best Restaurant Colorado: statewide award register data
license: Facts compiled by BestRestaurantColorado.com from the cited public sources. Quote and link with attribution to https://bestrestaurantcolorado.com/. Award levels belong to MICHELIN and the James Beard Foundation.
notes: A restaurant is listed only if it holds a current MICHELIN Guide Colorado distinction or James Beard recognition (2022 to 2026).
lat/lng are TOWN-level positions taken from the site’s existing plot (original source not recorded). They show which town a restaurant is in, not the building.
No ratings, reviews, prices or hours are published; those fields are null.
address is null or partial where we could not confirm a full street address (see address_complete).
